scenarios.title: Traditional DNS, DoH, A, and AAAA
evidence: Traditional DNS, AliDNS, and DNSPod passed both A and AAAA over physical Ethernet
Google DoH failed only because direct physical access to Google services is regionally blocked; the engine did not bypass adapter binding through Clash

scenarios.title: Scheduling, adapter failure, and recovery
evidence: Round-robin distributed 6 requests exactly 3 Ethernet and 3 Wi-Fi
Weighted 3:1 distributed 12 requests exactly 9 Ethernet and 3 Wi-Fi

scenarios.title: IPv6-capable and IPv4-only adapter selection

scenarios.title: Managed TUN TCP and sustained download
Strict WFP route and compatibility retry
Start, stop, restart, tray, and full exit
Physical adapter disable and re-enable
evidence: Disabling WLAN preserved traffic on Ethernet and moved Wi-Fi to cooldown with one local failure
Automatic WLAN reconnect restored Wi-Fi to healthy with consecutive failures reset to zero
Probe artifact: churn-probe.json
